_note: Paper Boat Post (prefix pb.). Words a child must READ never get a pre-answer clip: pb.w.* name PICTURES (docks, cards), pb.got.* / pb.s.* play only after the answer (or in the second-miss model, as pb.slow.*). Generated from content.ts; see docs/worlds/paper-boat-post.md §6.

pb.story.wind.text: One windy morning, the river was full of little paper boats.

pb.story.home.text: One by one, the paper boats bobbed home to their docks.

pb.dlg.hoot.text: Sarah has boats full of words for you!
pb.dlg.hoot.speaker: hoot

pb.dlg.handover.text: Hoot says you've been listening for rhymes. Rhymes help with reading!
pb.dlg.handover.speaker: sarah

pb.dlg.in.1.text: Hello! I'm Sarah, and this is my Paper Boat Post.
pb.dlg.in.1.speaker: sarah

pb.dlg.in.2.text: Every boat carries a word to a friend's dock!
pb.dlg.in.2.speaker: zuzu

pb.dlg.in.3.text: Whoosh! The wind tipped my post bag. The letters floated away!
pb.dlg.in.3.speaker: sarah

pb.dlg.in.4.text: Oh no! Now the boats don't know where to go.
pb.dlg.in.4.speaker: zuzu

pb.dlg.in.5.text: We need a careful reader. Let's send the boats!

pb.dlg.in.6.text: Read every letter, front to back. Ready?
